title: USB VIP example tb_usb_svt_uvm_20_b2b_phy -- Host<->Device VIP wired directly with no DUT
summary:
tb_usb_svt_uvm_20_b2b_phy is the 'back-to-back' PHY-only example: two nvs_usb_phy PHY-model instances are wired DIRECTLY to each other's DP/DM through a single shared `wor DP, DM` net in top_test.sv, with NO third DUT instance at all: `nvs_usb_phy SNPS_HOST_PHY_INST(...DP(DP), DM(DM)...); nvs_usb_phy SNPS_DEV_PHY_INST(...DP(DP), DM(DM)...);` -- both driven by the SAME usb_20_serial_if.usb_20_serial_if.clk1x_480Mhz clock generated in top_test.sv via an 8-phase manually-toggled generator (usb_20_simulation_cycle=2083 ps nominal UTMI cycle). top.sv itself is BYTE-IDENTICAL boilerplate to tb_usb_svt_uvm_20_phy/top.sv (just `include top_test.sv`); the entire difference lives in top_test.sv. Each side gets its own UTMI svt_usb_if (usb_20_utmi_host_if, usb_20_utmi_dev_if) registered to uvm_test_top.env via uvm_config_db#(virtual svt_usb_if)::set(...), plus a third usb_20_serial_if used purely for the differential bus monitor / serial clock source. This is the reference pattern for 'loopback'/VIP-to-VIP conformance testbenches with no RTL DUT.

env/usb_20_phy_env.sv, env/usb_shared_cfg.sv, env/usb_20_phy_base_test.sv mirror the tb_usb_svt_uvm_20_phy versions verbatim (same host_agent/dev_agent/sys_virt_sequencer construction, same objection_management fork/join_none). The env file inventory is a strict SUBSET of 20_phy's -- only ~20 sequence files retained (attach_bulk_xfers_detach_fs/hs, eop_detect_*, rx_random_xfers, suspend_*, host_resume): no lpm_*, no ulpi_*, no vbus_off_*, and NO CRC/bitstuff error-injection sequences/callbacks survive here -- those require a real PHY/DUT electrical boundary to inject errors on, which back-to-back VIP-to-VIP wiring doesn't have. Only response-shaping callbacks remain (usb_device_response_payload_callbacks.sv, in_xfers_payload_callbacks.sv, suspend_resume_callbacks.sv, svt_usb_fs_eop_error_callback.sv) since the device VIP must synthesize IN data with no real DUT function behind it. All 4 scoreboard files (usb_data/packet/transaction/transfer_scoreboard.sv) are present, same shape as 20_phy.
